translation.title: Corcovado through Tijuca Forest: Four-Hour Tour
translation.lead: After breakfast, depart on a four-hour excursion through the tropical Tijuca Forest towards the summit of Corcovado and the statue of Christ the Redeemer.
included: Admission tickets as specified in the itinerary.

hero.alt: Red Corcovado train amid the Tijuca Forest — illustration
hero.hover: Red Corcovado train amid the Tijuca Forest — illustration

translation.body: The viewpoint beside the monument reveals a sweeping panorama of Rio de Janeiro, its beaches, mountains and Guanabara Bay. Christ the Redeemer is one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.
